question_text: An online bookshop uses a normalized database with these tables: Book(BookID, Title, Price, GenreID), Genre(GenreID, GenreName) and Review(ReviewID, BookID, Rating). Each book's web page shows the title, price, genre name and average rating. Book pages are viewed about two million times per day, but genres are renamed only a few times per year and about 500 new reviews are added each day. A developer proposes denormalizing by adding GenreName and AverageRating columns to the Book table. Evaluate this proposal.
